cities.notes: hcsyria_micro_id is an old Aleppo copy and is not imported separately

project_number.imported: keeps the original MP_ID of its city unchanged
project_number.suggest: the form shows the next number of the selected city: max(sequence.next_number, MAX(project_number)+1)
project_number.edit: the user may type another number; it must be unused in the same city
project_number.save: inside one transaction: lock the city row of project_number_sequences, check the number, insert, then next_number = max(next_number, saved + 1); a duplicate returns a validation error with the next free number
project_number.display: <city code>-<number>, e.g. DAM-2354; search accepts DAM-2354, dam2354 or 2354 (within the permitted cities)
project_number.internal: every reference uses projects.id (BIGINT); the number is never a foreign key
project_number.floors: after import next_number = MAX(project_number)+1 per city (M3.5)

meta.other_numbers: Pay_ID, ExeF_ID, visit and M&E visit ids become internal ids; the original value stays in legacy_id. ExeF_No (the paper executive-file number) stays as typed text.

addendum_v1_3.reason: قرار المستخدم (21 تشرين الثاني 2026، M4.19): سجل الأحداث في الموقع يجب أن يشرح ما الذي تغيّر كما يفعل سجل برنامج سطح المكتب، لا نوع الحدث والسجل المعني فقط.

changes.account_audit_events: إضافة details (JSO: لأحداث التعديل فقط (إضافة، تعديل، حفظ، حذف، تغيير حالة): قائمة الحقول التي تغيّرت بالشكل {"fields":[{"field":"mobile","before":"0933…","after":"0944…"}]}. حتى 60 حقلاً، وكل قيمة حتى 200 حرف (الأطول يُقص ويُعلَّم). أحداث الاطلاع والدخول تبقى بدون تفاصيل.
changes.ما لا يُحفظ أبداً: كلمات المرور وبصماتها، الرموز (tokens)، كلمات المرور المؤقتة، محتوى المسودات المشفرة، ومحتوى الملفات المرفقة. الرقم الوطني يُسجَّل "تغيّر" فقط بدون القيمتين.
changes.من يقرأها: نفس من يقرأ السجل: من يحمل accounts.manage في مدينة الحدث (قرار 20 تشرين الثاني). السجل يبقى للإضافة فقط، لا تعديل ولا حذف.

addendum_v1_3.unchanged: لا تغيير على أي جدول أو عمود آخر، ولا على قواعد النقل. السجل القديم desktop_activity_log يبقى كما هو للقراءة فقط.

addendum_v1_2.reason: نقل قواعد المدن الخمس الحقيقية (M3) كشف أربعة أخطاء ربط وحقولاً أقصر من الداتا الحقيقية. كل ملاحظة تم التحقق منها في كود برنامج سطح المكتب.

changes.person_educations: education_grade_id ←: العمود Level_ID في تعليم الشخص هو الحالة الدراسية (متوقف/متخرج/طالب/غير متعلم). البرنامج يملؤه من جدول educationlevel (Application_New_Form.cs:864) والبحث يربطه به (Search_Form.cs:2313). في v1.1 ربطناه بجدول مستويات الحاجة A/BP/BF/C بالخطأ: تطابقت الأرقام صدفةً في حمص والوادي (قيم خاطئة بصمت) وفشلت في باقي المدن (3,972 سجلاً).
changes.حذف جدول education_grades (لا يُنقل جدول: جدول level (A, BP, BF, C) غير مستخدم في أي مكان من كود البرنامج.
changes.checklists: professional_test_account_id: فاحص الاختبار المهني يُختار من قائمة زوار الـChecklist (CheckList_Form.cs:305-335) وليس من المستخدمين. نفس الأرقام موجودة في الجدولين، فكان v1.1 سيعرض اسم شخص خاطئ.
changes.web_notices: إضافة legacy_pay_key: البرنامج يخزن رموز الإشعارات في Pay_ID عندما لا يكون قسطاً: ‎-21 زيارات Kobo، ‎-3 مشتريات، ‎-10 Trophy، ‎-1199 ملف تنفيذي، ‎-1000…-1039 دفعات تغيير حالة. حوالي 279,000 إشعار تحمل رمزاً، والبرنامج يعتمد عليها.
changes.أطوال الحقول: الرقم الوطني والموبايل وال: أطول القيم الحقيقية: 50 و38 و32 و50 و102 و200 حرفاً. بدون التعديل كانت 3,658 قيمة ستُقص.

addendum_v1_1.reason: the account tables marked existing in v1 had foreign keys to the removed layers (web_principals, sources, op_task, op_microproject); they are now defined explicitly with links to the unified tables

removed_tables.principal_capabilities: صلاحيات لكل مصدر؛ يحل محلها account_city_capabilities
removed_tables.source_publications: نشر نسخة مصدر؛ لا حاجة له مع قاعدة واحدة

addendum_v1_1.unchanged: account_city_capabilities, account_city_roles, account_password_resets, account_audit_events keep their columns
addendum_v1_1.data_and_rules: no business data, permission rule or transfer rule changes

meta.deletes: business rows are soft-deleted (deleted_at) by permitted roles and audited; hard delete only by administrators

transforms.trim: leading/trailing spaces removed; empty string -> null
transforms.bool01: 1/0, YES/Yes/NO/No, Paid/Not Paid -> true/false; anything else -> null + migration_exceptions
transforms.date: valid dates kept; null, zero or before 1900 -> null + migration_exceptions (desktop "set later" values keep their original text there)
transforms.sex: ذكر -> male, أنثى -> female; empty (1,532 people) -> null; 3 malformed values -> null + exception
transforms.currency: loan Currency SP -> SYP, USD -> USD (3,065 / 40 loans)
transforms.money: float/double -> DECIMAL(15,2), rounded half-up; any change above 0.005 is recorded
transforms.lookup: per city, legacy id -> unified lookup through lookup_legacy_map. Values are merged by normalised Arabic name (trim, unify ي/ى, ة/ه, alef forms). Same id with different names in different cities is normal (for example 87 of 100 street ids) and is resolved per city
transforms.project: MicroProject_ID -> projects.id of the same city
transforms.person: Person_ID -> people.id of the same city
transforms.account: (city, legacy UserID) -> web account through account_legacy_links; an unmapped user keeps null plus the legacy id in migration_exceptions
transforms.file: image.image_NewPath: file copied from the city FTP folder to private storage (M5.4); file.File_Content (Aleppo, 32 rows) written to private storage
transforms.checklist_project: checklist and checklist_member_opinions: project = the person's only project; 40 Aleppo checklists of people with several projects use the project whose request date is closest before the checklist dates, and are listed for review
transforms.me_visit_project: me_visits: project from kobo_monitoring_record when present, else the person's only project; 19 Aleppo visits of people with several projects are listed for review
transforms.visit_answers: visit.AnsN/AnsN_Value (N=1..7), rehabvisit (1..15) and office_monitoring (1..6) become one row per answered question; 2 duplicate office_monitoring rows (Homs, Latakia) are both kept as separate answers sets and listed for review
transforms.latakia_person_extras: person.P_Goal, P_GoalHow, P_OtherNotes, P_WorkYears (Latakia only) fill the empty fields of the person's project_applicants row; non-empty conflicts go to migration_exceptions
transforms.not_answered: the desktop writes -1 (and 0 in lists that have no 0 value) for "not answered": yes/no fields and list references with such values become empty without an exception (e.g. 2,504 checklist opinions and 391 has-work answers in Latakia)
transforms.required_text: a required text field that is empty in the source is stored as empty text and noted (e.g. 76 Kobo user mappings without a form id apply to every form), so the row is not dropped
transforms.deleted_users: a reference to a desktop user that no longer exists in the user table gets a placeholder desktop user "deleted user #N" (disabled, no password), so the reference is kept (53 visit visitors)
transforms.imported_accounts: each desktop user becomes its own web account, disabled until the duplicate-account review (M4.1) enables or merges it; role and duties are mapped to the web roles
transforms.notice_kind: notice type from the body text: number with an instalment = payment, تم تبديل = state, المشتريات = purchases, Visit (Trophy) = trophy, Visit = visit, براءة الذمة = clearance, التنفيذي = executive file, otherwise message
transforms.attachment_ids: attachments.legacy_id keeps the source id: image as is, file negated, meeting attachment negated + 10,000,000, so the three sources never collide
transforms.profession_meeting_state: rows without Record_State (Aleppo backup of 22 Oct) -> final

source_findings.structure: the five cities share the same tables and columns; only Latakia person has 4 extra columns and Homs/AlWadi store two loan amounts as double
source_findings.aleppo: the 19 Nov Aleppo backup stops after profession_meeting (95 of ~140 tables); the 22 Oct backup is used for design until a complete one is provided
source_findings.empty: purchasing, purchasingcategory and microproject_ag_answer are empty in every city; rehabilitation (2 projects), executive files (145) and stored files (32) exist only in Aleppo
source_findings.orphans: no applicant rows without a project and no installments without a loan in any city

migration_runs.note: one row per import of one city backup (archive hash, counts, status)

migration_exceptions.note: every value that could not be transferred exactly (bad date, missing reference, unknown user)

people.note: Latakia-only P_Goal, P_GoalHow, P_OtherNotes, P_WorkYears move to the person's project_applicants row when that row is empty; otherwise kept in migration_exceptions

project_agriculture_answers.note: empty in all five cities; kept for the agriculture annex (user decision M0.5)

checklists.note: the desktop keys a checklist by person; project_id is filled when the person has exactly one project, otherwise recorded in migration_exceptions

purchases.note: empty in all cities; kept (user decision M0.5)

visit_answers.note: one row per question; replaces the wide AnsN / AnsN_Value columns of three tables

me_visits.note: the desktop keys M&E visits by person; project_id is filled from the Kobo monitoring record or the person's only project

kobo_forms.source: kobo_form_mapping + kobo_monitoring_field_mapping + kobo_opening_field_mapping + kobo_monitoring_stage_mapping (joined on Kobo_Form_UID)

kobo_submissions.note: local_table/local_record_id are re-pointed to visits.id or me_visits.id

profession_meetings.note: Aleppo 22 Oct rows have no Record_State: imported as final

legacy_staff_users.addendum: جديد: بدل web_principals. مستخدمو البرنامج لكل مدينة مع كلمة مرورهم المشفرة، لأول دخول وربط السجلات القديمة بالحسابات
legacy_staff_users.note: password_hash keeps the desktop PBKDF2-SHA256 value; it is checked on first web login and the account then gets an Argon2id hash. Role 6 (out of service) gets disabled_at. ProfilePicture is not imported

web_accounts.addendum: تعديل: credential_principal_id يصبح credential_legacy_user_id ويرتبط بـ legacy_staff_users
web_accounts.note: CHECK (password_hash IS NOT NULL OR credential_legacy_user_id IS NOT NULL)

account_legacy_links.addendum: تعديل: الربط بـ (city_id, legacy_staff_user_id) بدل (source_id, principal_id)
account_legacy_links.note: used by tx:account: (city, legacy UserID) -> account

account_city_tasks.addendum: تعديل: المهمة ترتبط بـ task_definitions (task_definition_id) بدل op_task

account_audit_events.addendum: v1.3: إضافة details (الحقول التي تغيّرت، قبل وبعد)

audit_events.addendum: تعديل: city_id بدل source_id، وactor_account_id (الحساب) بدل actor_principal_id
audit_events.note: every web action from now on

web_notices.addendum: تعديل: حذف source_id، وproject_id يرتبط بـ projects، وloan_installment_id (القسط) بدل pay_key، وإضافة legacy_id وretired_by_kobo (معلن عنهما في v1)
web_notices.note: kind IN (visit, clearance, payment, trophy, executive_file, state, purchases, message); kobo_visit_schedule.Retired sets retired_by_kobo

attachments.note: image rows point to FTP files (image_NewPath); file rows hold the content in the database (Aleppo, 32 rows) and are written to private storage

desktop_activity_log.note: read-only history of the desktop log (about 660,000 rows); new activity goes to audit_events

not_imported.databases: desktop city list; replaced by cities
not_imported.role: role names; mapped to the web roles
not_imported.level: need levels A/BP/BF/C; not used by the desktop code (v1.2)
not_imported.manualfile: desktop manual (Aleppo, Latakia 1 row); the web has its own help page
not_imported.dept: Damascus temporary copy of person_microproject.P_HasDebts; all 2,043 values equal the main table (checked 19 Nov)
not_imported.work_exp: Damascus older copy of person_microproject.P_WorkYears; 14 of 2,371 values were edited later in the main table, which stays authoritative
